config.label: URL of your Actual Budget server, for example http://localhost:5006
config.description: URL of your Actual Budget server, for example http://localhost:5006

config.label: Password for your Actual Budget server
config.description: Password for your Actual Budget server. Not needed if you set ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN

config.label: Session token for servers behind OIDC, which have no password
config.description: Session token for servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use instead of ACTUAL_PASSWORD; if both are set, the token wins

config.label: Your budget's Sync ID, found under Settings > Show advanced settings
config.description: Your budget's Sync ID, found under Settings > Show advanced settings

config.label: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted
config.description: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted

config.label: Every budget this server serves, comma separated, when it is more than one
config.description: Every budget this server serves, comma separated, when it is more than one. Each tool then takes a budget_id, and each budget is opened in a process of its own

config.label: A JSON object of budget sync id to encryption password, for when more than one of the budgets is encrypted
config.description: A JSON object of budget sync id to encryption password, for when more than one of the budgets is encrypted. Each worker is given its own and never the map

config.label: How many budgets stay open at once
config.description: How many budgets stay open at once. Defaults to 3. A fourth budget closes the one that went longest without a call

config.label: How long an open budget with nothing to do stays open
config.description: How long an open budget with nothing to do stays open. Defaults to 15

config.label: How long a call waits for a budget that is still opening before it answers that it is still opening
config.description: How long a call waits for a budget that is still opening before it answers that it is still opening. Defaults to 45

config.label: Set to 1 to hide every write tool from the model, exposing only reads and analysis
config.description: Set to 1 to hide every write tool from the model, exposing only reads and analysis

config.label: Set to chat to offer the 18 everyday tools instead of all 44, which is 17
config.description: Set to chat to offer the 18 everyday tools instead of all 44, which is 17.4 KiB of tool descriptions instead of 39.7 KiB on every connection. Defaults to full

config.label: Directory for the local budget cache
config.description: Directory for the local budget cache

config.label: How long to wait for your server to start replying, in milliseconds
config.description: How long to wait for your server to start replying, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000; raise it if a GoCardless bank sync is being cut off

config.label: Serve MCP over HTTP on this port instead of stdio
config.description: Serve MCP over HTTP on this port instead of stdio. Only for a server you run yourself and point clients at: a client that starts this package itself speaks stdio and cannot reach it once this is set

config.label: The credential for the read path, /mcp
config.description: The credential for the read path, /mcp. Required once ACTUAL_HTTP_PORT is set, and at least 32 characters

config.label: A second credential, for the write path, /mcp-write
config.description: A second credential, for the write path, /mcp-write. Without it the server serves no write path at all

config.label: What to bind to
config.description: What to bind to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; inside a container that is unreachable, so 0.0.0.0 together with ACTUAL_HTTP_ALLOW_REMOTE

config.label: Set to 1 to bind somewhere other than loopback
config.description: Set to 1 to bind somewhere other than loopback. Nothing here terminates TLS, so put something in front of it that does

config.label: Hostnames to accept in the Host header, comma separated and without ports, for a server that is not on loopback
config.description: Hostnames to accept in the Host header, comma separated and without ports, for a server that is not on loopback. Anything else is answered 403
